scope: Exact generic algebraic rank of E over Q(U), not specialized rank, analytic equality or BSD
claim_statement: For E_U: y^2+y=x^3+U(U+1)x^2/2-(U(U+1)+2)x/2, rank E(Q(U))=3 as an application of Battistoni-Bettin-Delaunay, Theorem 1 (2021 preprint).

gates.name: Statement and source provenance
gates.checks: Specified field Q(U), exact published theorem, source edition and formula case; does not state all rational specializations.
gates.limitations: Independent expert review and source-signature authentication not done.

gates.name: Exact computational proof inputs
gates.checks: Factor F, compute resultants and factor count; check quartic irreducibility mod 3 and modular gcd discriminant.
gates.limitations: Algebra checks alone do not prove a general published theorem.

gates.name: Published-theorem hypotheses
gates.checks: Verify degree 2 A,B, monic degree 3 C, both Upsilon terms, gcd degrees, non-square of A, theorem rank count.
gates.limitations: The theorem is external; the application has not been independently refereed.

gates.name: Alternative geometric falsification
gates.checks: Rational elliptic surface, eight I1 finite fibers, I4 infinity, Shioda–Tate geometric rank 5; distinct from rational rank 3.
gates.limitations: Uses standard external geometric classification and Shioda–Tate theorem.

gates.name: Novelty, specialization, analytic-rank overclaim
gates.checks: Test rank drops at u=1 and -2; verify generic rank does not imply exact specialized rank; no analytic equality asserted.
gates.limitations: No independently established novelty or infinite exact specialized rank/analytic comparison.

policy: Five ResearchOS/TECT-inspired adversarial research passes, not canonical TECT execution or assurance.
